en:
Still, T-Set's no doubt gonna give ya a run for your money.
We can't count on round two goin' the same way. You're gonna
have to work for it!

Once ya feel confident, select "Princess League" from the
schedule board. Good luck, Haruka!

What a shame, huh, Haruka? I think maybe ya let your guard
down a little bit.

Once you're fully prepared and feelin' confident, select
"Princess League" from the schedule board. You can do this,
Haruka!

Way to go, kid! Your singin' never sounded better! Only
thing left is that all-important final round!

But T-Set is gonna come at ya, guns blazin'. You gotta make
sure you're completely prepared!
You did it, Haruka! You really did it!
Congratulations, Haruka. That was a brilliant performance.
Thank you! I couldn't have done it without everyone's help.

Park-san really found a gem in you. I'm sure she's real
proud, Haruka.
Yamaura-san...

Here's a little something for all your hard work. Think of
it as a gift from Park-san.
You got <Color:8>Cutie Girl Sticks<Color:Default>.
Wow, thank you!

I bet ya feel like a real weight has been lifted, huh? Now
you can spend your time however ya like⑬at least for a
little while.
Okay! Thank you!
Congratulations, Haruka! Truly!

Once ya feel confident, select "Princess League" from the
"Princess League" from the schedule board. You can do this,
Haruka!

Hey, kid. Round one of the Princess League is almost here,
huh?

Until then, do work or take lessons to up your skills. Once
you feel confident, select "Princess League" from the
schedule board.
Good luck, Haruka!

Just check out "Princess League" on the schedule board
whenever you're ready.
Whaddya think, Haruka? Ready to head out to the Princess League taping?
But listen to me, Haruka...

If ya beat T-Set today, your face is gonna be known all over
the country.
There's no going back to a regular life after that. I want you to be prepared.

So if there's anything ya wanna get outta the way first,
now's the time to do it.
Right, okay.
Okay, ready to go?
I'm sorry. Could I have just a little more time?
Sure, just come on back when you're ready.
Yes, I'm all set.
Great! Let's get started, then.

There ya are, Haruka. Not much time until the Princess
League.
Whaddya wanna do? You wanna go now?
There ain't much time left, ya know. You wanna go now?

That's fine, but we're cutting it pretty close. Don't take
too long.
Okay, I won't.
I'm ready to go to the Princess League.
Great! You look ready!

Okay, take a look at the schedule board, and check out the
part that says "Princess League."
All set? Let's go!

This will work out great! She's gonna be performing at
Castle Records, they said. Get out there and get that
autograph!

Haruka, if ya don't hurry up and get over to that audition,
the positions'll get filled! You ready to go?

I'm afraid I'm not ready to go just yet. I want to prepare a
little first.
There you are, Haruka. Ready to hear about that audition?

That's right. This one'll be a little different from
a regular audition, however. It's gonna be a joint audition
this time around.
Really? You mean right now?

Good morning, Haruka. Today, we begin your lessons in
earnest.

We don't have much time left, so I'm really going to need
your focus. Now, are you ready to begin?
Haruka, are you ready now?
Time is money, as they say. Do try to hurry.
I'm ready. Thank you for doing this!
It's my pleasure. Let's get started.
Oh, Haruka-chan. How did it go? No major mishaps?
I think it went okay...

Musta been a rough assignment. But there'll be plenty more
like it in the future, I'm sure.
Don't let it get to you.

I won't. By the way, what's my schedule like for the rest of
the day?
Oh, Park-san didn't tell ya?
Tell me what?

She said that, when you get back, she's gonna take you out
shoppin' for cute clothes and whatnot.
In fact, she's probably waitin' for ya at the office right now.
She remembered...
She's a real woman of action, that Park-san.
We'd better scoot back.
Oh, that's right! I gotta stop by the drugstore first.
The drugstore?

Yeah, for Park-san's hand. It's still swollen, so she asked
me to pick up a compress.
I'll go with you, then. I've been worried about her hand.
Okay, great. Ready to go, then?
Ready.
Oh, hello, Haruka. Come for a lesson, have you?

I'm glad to see your enthusiasm, but you look exhausted. If
you can't focus properly, you may end up getting hurt. You
really should rest first.
All right. I understand.

Very well. Let's begin. Why don't you tell me what you'd
like to work on?
(I think I'll try an easy "Loneliness Loop" lesson.)
(I think I'll try "Loneliness Loop.")
(I think I'll try a hard "Loneliness Loop" lesson.)
(I think I'll try an easy "Because I Have You" lesson.)
(I think I'll try "Because I Have You.")
(I think I'll try a hard "Because I Have You" lesson.)

I see. All right, well, when you're ready for a lesson, just
come let me know anytime.

Um... How am I doing so far? Do you really think I can win
the Princess League?
With your abilities as they stand right now?

Well, to be honest, I think it'd be pretty difficult.
There's still quite a gap between you and your opponents. You
have to hone your skills.

Hmm. It might be a little difficult. However, if you manage
to pull off a particularly flawless performance, it could
very well be possible.

Yes, I think you have a real chance, but you have to be
cautious. If you lose focus, your opponents could still
catch you.

You know, I think you can. Provided you don't make any serious
mistakes and can perform to your usual ability, I'm almost
certain you can win.

Oh, did you? Well, when you're ready for a lesson, just let
me know anytime.
Saejima-san! Good to see you!
Hey. Is Majima around?
Nah, the boss hasn't been by.
Huh. Guess I dropped in too early.
Looks like it. By the way, isn't this your last night on the outside?
You should enjoy some time on the town while you can. Least that's what I'd do if I were you.
Besides, it might be good to get out and spread your wings a bit. Your ass-kicking wings, I mean.
A bigtime Tojo name like you is sure to get recognized in jail, and someone in there might even be dumb enough to try and fight you.
Not that I doubt you can hold your own, of course. But with all the punks in town, why not hit two birds with one stone?
It'll help you knock some of the rust off, <Italic>and</Italic> send a bloody message to anyone who's thinking about taking a shot at you in prison.
I'm about to turn myself in, and you're tellin' me to go raise hell? What kinda fool are ya?
Sorry, sir. I just thought...
It's all good. And hey, ya ain't wrong. This town's in a rough spot. Too many idiots runnin' around not givin' a shit about anyone else.
...Yeah, y'know what? Maybe I will go enjoy myself. Like ya said, I oughta get the most outta this place while I can.
Yes! See you later, sir!
Oh, you're back!
Majima here yet?
Nah, the boss must've had a lot to do first.
Huh. Looks like I gotta come back later, then.
Sure! See you later tonight, sir!
Saejima-san! It's good to see you.
Majima here?
Oh, yes. He's right inside, ready and waiting for you.
(Majima's waitin' for me. But should I blow off some more steam before seein' him? Only got a few hours left of freedom, after all.)
Good to see you, sir! The boss is waiting for you inside.
Just remembered an errand I gotta run. Tell Majima to wait just a little longer, will ya?
Will do, sir! He never does like waiting, but I think he'll make an exception for you!
Better go say my final goodbye.
Hey, Nishida? While I'm gone... look after Majima for me, will ya?
Of course, sir! And you look after yourself, too!
Whew. I managed to win, somehow!
Un, if you're willing, I'd love to play you again!
Ouch. You got me.
Here, take these, as thanks for your time.
You got <Color:8>Limited-ed. Color Torpedo Barrel and Point<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Rocket Shot Flight and Shaft<Color:Default>.
Uh, please don't get angry, but I want to tell you something.
I, uh, don't get nervous when I play other people anymore. Except you, Saejima-san.
Like, uh, you're intimidating, Saejima-san, just from the way you look, so playing you was like good training, I mean...
Is that so? Good to hear.
Yes, it was a great experience. Thank you very much.
By the way, weren't ya sayin' you're gonna enter a big tournament?
Yes, I am. I'll do my best!
Um, may I challenge you to a darts match?
Some other time.
Oh, I'm sorry, you must be busy. Please give me a shout if you'd like to play.
Trainin' hard, huh? Sure thing. I'll play ya.
Oh, thank you so much. Okay, let's play cricket!
Whew. I squeaked out a win.
You're plenty good now, Ebi-chan. Why do ya need more trainin'?
I suppose... But I don't think I've played to the best of my ability yet. I'd like to keep playing with you, if I may.
Ouch. You got me. I tense up when I get nervous.
Looks that way. You seem to be settlin' down a little, though.
Uh, yes, I think so, too. Please take these, as thanks for playing with me today.
You got <Color:8>Tungsten Torpedo Barrel and Point<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Beware of Bears Flight and Shaft<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Grandpa's Handmade Flight and Shaft<Color:Default>.
Um, if you have the time, I hope you'll play with me again.
Uh, um, would you like to play a game of darts?
Uh-huh, sure.
Okay! Then, could we play a cricket match?
Whew. I won. I'm so glad!
Um, if you have the time, please play with me again. I'm a regular here.
Aww... Guess I'm not good enough after all.
Oh, yes, Saejima-san, these are my thanks for your time today.
You got <Color:8>Tungsten Straight Barrel and Point<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Slim Flight and Shaft<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Standard Flight and Shaft<Color:Default>.
They're parts for customizing darts.
You can combine them to make your own custom darts. It's kind of fun.
Um, please play with me again if you get a chance.
I'm busy.
Oh, uh, sorry to bother you.
Oh, uh, then I'd like to challenge you to a game of cricket.
You will? Thank you.
I'm thinking of entering a major tournament...
But when I play someone, I get so nervous that I fumble and mess up! I do so well by myself, but with someone else, I'm just hopeless...
So that's why you're challenging strangers to play?
Yes. I thought maybe if I could get over this anxiety of mine, then maybe...
Oh, yeah. I get it. I'm Saejima. You, what do ya go by?
Uh, Ebisu.
Ebisu? What, is that your last name? I'll just call ya Ebi-chan. That's good. Now, let's play.
...Ebi-chan? Uh, um, yes, a cricket match, please.
I win! Hahaha. I'm getting pretty good at this, huh? Let's do it again sometime!
Damn it. I lost.
Oh, yeah. Here's a little something for playing with me today.
You got <Color:8>Limited-edition Color Barrel and Point<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Sweet Flight and Shaft<Color:Default>.
Man, all that practice for nothing. Guess I don't have what it takes yet.
You make a good opponent, though.
It's been fun hanging out. Thank you!
Glad to hear it. Didn't you say you had a tournament coming up?
Yeah. It's just a little one for amateurs, though. Can't wait to see how high I'll rank!
Hey! I've been practicing up a storm lately, and I think I'm really getting the hang of this. Let's play a game!
Oh, okay. That's a shame. Well, say the word if you ever feel like playing, okay?
Yay! Okay, we'll play 301. No need to cut me any slack!
I win! Hahaha. I told you I'd been honing my skills. Let's play another game sometime!
How did you get so good at this?
Nothing, sorry. Oh, yeah! Do you want these? I don't need them anymore.
You got <Color:8>Brass Torpedo Barrel and Point<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Hito-nyan Flight and Shaft<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Flashy Butterfly Flight and Shaft<Color:Default>.
I'm going to brush up on my skills. Give me another shot at beating you later, okay?!
Hey! I put in some practice, and I'm playing way better now. Want another game of darts with me?
Okay, let's play 301. This should be fun!
All right! I won! Let's play another game sometime!
Gah! I lost. Damn it!
Nothing, sorry. Oh, yeah! You can have these as thanks for playing with me today!
